The '''Sarpazia system''' was located in the [[Illodia sector/Legends|Illodia sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="SouthernCore" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sarpazian Rose]]''.<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]] {{C|game manual}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sarpazia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
